items.raw_excerpt: Deaf musicians have shaped classical music for centuries, but only recently have innovations like haptic vests and Auslan signers enabled deeper connections.
items.summary_en: Deaf musicians have shaped classical music for centuries. New technologies like haptic vests help deaf people feel music through vibrations. Auslan signers also create deeper connections at performances.

items.title_en: How Deaf people connect with music, from Beethoven to haptic vests

items.raw_excerpt: New government rules mandate e-commerce platforms to resolve complaints within a month and disclose pricing details from January 2027.
items.summary_en: New Indian government rules will require online shopping platforms to resolve customer complaints within 30 days. Starting January 2027, platforms must also show clear pricing details. The rules aim to protect online shoppers.
items.summary_ko: 인도 정부의 새 규정은 온라인 쇼핑 플랫폼이 고객 클레임을 30일 이내에 해결하도록 요구한다. 2027년 1월부터 플랫폼은 가격 정보를 명확히 공개해야 하며, 이 규제는 온라인 소비자를 보호하기 위한 것이다.
items.title_en: India to require e-commerce platforms to resolve customer complaints within one month

items.title_original: E-commerce platforms should settle complaints in  a month, say new govt. rules

items.raw_excerpt: Kolkata law college's Vice Principal resigns after student protest over attendance, claiming targeting amid political tensions and demands for justice.
items.summary_en: The vice principal of a law college in Kolkata resigned after students held a 23-hour protest over attendance rules. She claimed she was being targeted due to political tensions. The students had demanded justice and accountability.

items.raw_excerpt: La Dirección Meteorológica de Chile (DMC) pronosticó jornadas templadas con máximas de entre 18 °C y 23 °C durante la semana de Fiestas Patrias -del 16 al 19 de septiembre- en la zona central, junto a nubosidad parcial, posibles chubascos en la precordillera hacia el domingo 20 y el ingreso de un nuevo sistema frontal con lluvias entre el 21 y el 24 de este mes. "En general nos vamos a mantener con buenas condiciones para los días 16, 17 y 18 (...) hacia el día 19 debiéramos estar con cielo nubl
items.summary_en: Chile's meteorological agency predicts mild temperatures with highs of 18 to 23 degrees Celsius during Fiestas Patrias from September 16 to 19 in the central zone. Partial cloud cover and possible showers are expected in the pre-Andean areas by Sunday the 20th. A new frontal system is forecast to bring rain from September 21 to 24.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 기상청은 9월 16~19일 건국절 축제 기간 중부 지역에서 최고 기온 18~23도의 따뜻한 날씨를 예상했습니다. 20일 일요일에는 산간 지역에 부분적인 흐림과 소나기가 예고되며, 21~24일에는 새로운 기후 전선이 유입되면서 비가 내릴 전망입니다.
